clips.title: The story
paras: First Mate Fitzsimmons believes that the restless curse binding his fallen crewmates stems from a dark artifact secured aboard their wrecked ship, the Intrepid. To set his brethren free, an adventurer must face the ghost of Captain Halyndor, take the strongbox key, and recover the relic from the submerged hull.

First Mate Fitzsimmons survived the tragic fate of the Third Fleet, but the memory of his comrades haunts his waking hours and his dreams. He remains convinced that the undeath gripping his shipmates is tied to a mysterious, malignant object locked away inside the strongbox of his old vessel, the Intrepid. Overseeing the wreck is the spectral remnants of Captain Halyndor, who even in death fiercely guards the key to the vessel's deepest secrets.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To break the curse and free all of my brethren, the...thing...stowed on my ship must be retrieved and cleansed! I don't know what it was, but I do know that it was stored securely in the ship's strongbox, which Captain Halyndor lorded over.
My old captain is still in my dreams. I know he walks my doomed ship, the Intrepid. Get the key from him, and use it to open the Intrepid's strongbox.
Then, after you have the cursed thing, bring it to the priest Glorin Steelbrow in town.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The key is rusted but it fits the lock neatly.
